dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: A short break with a cup of tea is the best way to wash away all your fatigue.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: My teacup is hidden just behind this card.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: You're staring... Are you trying to say you want some tea, too?

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Looks like delving into this domain is gonna be challenging.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: As a magician's assistant, what I'm good at is executing a specific plan. And trying not to make any mistakes in the process.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: #So, do you have a plan in place for showtime, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: It seems like stories are highly valued here, right?

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: From what I remember, most stories are just a bunch of lies made up by adults.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: I still made sure to listen along all beady-eyed when someone was telling a story, though. Apparently, kids who are too smart get on people's nerves.
